primary_task.name: log10_contact_resistance_regression
primary_task.physical_significance: Represents orders-of-magnitude contact resistance scaling; 0.1 dex error = 26% error.

auxiliary_task.name: schottky_barrier_height_regression
auxiliary_task.physical_significance: Measures interfacial potential barrier governing thermionic carrier injection.

independent_single_task.description: Fit separate estimators for log10_rc and Phi_B. Maximizes parameter dedication and prevents negative transfer in small-N regime.
independent_single_task.rationale: Given N=20, independent models prevent cross-task parameter interference and allow distinct regularizers for each target.

joint_multi_task.description: Multi-output regressor optimizing shared loss: L = L(log10_rc) + lambda * L(Phi_B).
joint_multi_task.rationale: High target correlation (r=0.816) theoretically aids joint learning, but small sample size risks joint optimization instabilities.

physics_chained_hybrid.description: Stage 1 predicts Phi_B; Stage 2 predicts log10_rc using Stage 1 prediction as a dynamic input feature alongside carrier density.
physics_chained_hybrid.rationale: Directly embodies the thermionic emission physics: Rc ~ exp(q * Phi_B / kT).
